'''Long yams''' are an [[aboveground]] [[crop|garden plant]]. They can be planted in all seasons and are edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]]. Long yams are the only type of yam that can be eaten raw.

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[preferences|like]] long yam plants for their ''tubers''.
